prompt: Which statement correctly separates a template repository from a fork?
explanation: Templates are molds: new repository, empty history, no relationship to the mold. Forks are contributions-in-waiting: full copy of history, linked so you can open pull requests back upstream and sync changes down.

options.text: A template starts a new history; a fork copies history and stays linked to its upstream
A fork starts a new history; a template copies history and stays linked
Both create fresh histories with no upstream link
Both copy history and stay linked to the upstream
